title: Cross-platform package qualification
objective: Provide target-parameterized fresh-install npm and relocated SEA numerical smoke qualification across all supported platforms without workspace leakage

oracles: fresh temporary install executes representative public numerical operations

handoff.summary: Added isolated production-archive installation, target-parameterized public API and numerical smoke qualification, arbitrary-source npm/SEA runners for P8 adapters, and adversarial cross-platform command/layout/lifecycle tests. The root-only consumer proves platform selection through the root archive's exact optional dependency. Qualification now validates private copies of both tar streams before installation, rejects links, traversal, special entries, and portable-path collisions, and audits installed package closures without following links or Windows junctions/reparse points. Linux x64 passed against the production root and platform archives, including lazy cminpack/NLopt and a separately relocated SEA.
risks: The committed runner is platform-neutral, but production archives still need to be executed on the persistent Linux ARM64, macOS ARM64, and Windows x64 hosts after integration provides their current artifacts.
next_steps: Bind the runner APIs into P8's authoritative corpus adapters without duplicating corpus or receipt files.
Run `pnpm release:qualify:package -- --target <matching-target>` on each persistent release host and attach those receipts to P8 qualification.
